source.title: New WEC Leader
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Walker Welch will become the new Leader of the WCA Ethics Committee (WEC). Walker was already working as a member of the WEC.

Walker was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a voting among the current Committee/Team Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion 10.2017.0](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NDLzup8rbfw8En0S6vtChNti9IKopDBq/edit) about WCA Committees and Teams.

We wish Walker the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties!

The new Leader will be promoted immediately. Walker Welch was one among five applicants for the position and all candidacy documents can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1jTi6utpP6qK2AOKfeSdQ-lVzB2MbM3ir) for anyone interested in viewing them.

List of the other candidates who applied:
     - Joseph Blas
     - Abhijeet Ghodgaonkar
     - Callum Goodyear
     - Chris Krueger

translation.title: WCA 道德委员会新负责人
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Walker Welch 将出任 WCA 道德委员会（WEC）的新任负责人。Walker 此前已是 WEC 成员。

WCA 董事会依照[《议案 10.2017.0：委员会与团队》](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NDLzup8rbfw8En0S6vtChNti9IKopDBq/edit)第 4 节选出 Walker，并经现任委员会、团队负责人及高级代表投票确认。

祝 Walker 在新的岗位上一切顺利！

新负责人将立即就任。Walker Welch 是五位申请人之一，所有申请材料均可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1jTi6utpP6qK2AOKfeSdQ-lVzB2MbM3ir)查看。

其他申请人名单：

- Joseph Blas
- Abhijeet Ghodgaonkar
- Callum Goodyear
- Chris Krueger
